newsitem.title: FINLAND: OUTOKUMPU TO DELIVER TECHNOLOGY TO BOLIDEN.
newsitem.headline: OUTOKUMPU TO DELIVER TECHNOLOGY TO BOLIDEN.

text.p: Finnish mining and metals group Outokumpu Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it would supply flash smelting technology to Sweden's Boliden Mineral AB's Ronnskar copper smelting expansion project.

"Outokumpu's technology delivery, including design work and equipment, will mean some tens of millions of dollars (to Outokumpu)," Outokumpu Engineering Contractors Oy's vice president for sales Pekka Hanniala told Reuters by telephone.
The delivery would be part of Boliden's smelter expansion, estimated to cost around $200 million, Outokumpu said in the statement.
The expansion and building of the new flash smelting line would raise the smelter's capacity to at least 220,000 tonnes of copper per year, Outokumpu said.
